title: Random abacus
action: Touch, compare rates and axes, withdraw, replay.
material_fact: Contact displaces the contacting virtual hand along a stored path; the viewpoint and tracked controller stay in place.

evidence.claim: The hand target adds the sphere displacement to controller tracking; withdrawal releases it.
48 stored positions; rows 1–4 share X at 0.4, 0.8, 1.6 and 3.2 segments per second. Row 5 adds Y within ±0.12 metres at the second row's rate.
Five one-metre rods in front of a pale recording wall, with small beads and one large REPLAY button. Translucent circles retain path samples; only the contacting virtual hand moves.

primary.author: Sara Ahmed
primary.operation: Attend to what contact, direction and withdrawal make available.

counterpoint.author: Georges Perec
counterpoint.operation: Stay with one unchanged turn or distance rather than naming orientation.

refusal: Do not narrate physical force on the hand or body travel here.
Do not assign a sensation to every participant.
